title: Financial authorization and integrity
criteria: Every money-moving path is deterministic, authorized by a human or an established recurring authority outside any AI model, balanced, idempotent and reconciled; no AI authorizes money (ODP-10).
required_evidence: Invariant-suite results for the release; authority-model tests showing AI cannot authorize; reconciliation run on synthetic populations; verifier-bound receipts

title: Regulatory characterization of the activated flow
criteria: The flow to be activated has a recorded regulatory characterization from primary-source research and multiple-agent analysis; unresolved legal risk keeps the flow inactive while technical functionality may be built (ODP-05, ODP-12). Internal research is never represented as legal opinion.
required_evidence: Primary-source research memo and prepared question package for the flow; funds-flow role table; activation record citing the resolution or the recorded owner risk decision

title: Tenant and fund isolation
criteria: Tenant and fund context is enforced at the database and application boundary and cannot be bypassed by application code (Strata runtime, ODP-07).
required_evidence: Cross-tenant negative test results; database policy verification; Strata failure-simulation and recovery-validation results

title: Security validation
criteria: Continuous internal security testing covers the release scope with no open critical or high finding past its deadline; a risk-based assessment of the need for external testing is recorded before material activation (ODP-11).
required_evidence: Continuous testing coverage report; findings register extract; recorded external-testing assessment

title: Backup, recovery and replay
criteria: Restore and controlled replay have been exercised on synthetic data within the stated recovery objectives; retention and disposal rules are configured.
required_evidence: Restore test record with measured recovery time and point; replay test results; retention configuration export

title: Privileged access and evidence integrity
criteria: No standing production or financial access; break-glass with independent alerting; the evidence store is not writable by administrators of the evidence it holds (ODP-03). Residual concentration risk and its triggers are recorded (RSK-065).
required_evidence: Access-as-code export; break-glass test with alert receipt; evidence-store permission test

title: Operational evidence and observability
criteria: Evidence is emitted by construction at enforcement points, expected sources are monitored by heartbeat through shared observability, and missing evidence is a failure, never a pass (TNT-17, ODP-06).
required_evidence: Evidence-type coverage report for the release; heartbeat alert test; completeness reconciliation on synthetic data

title: Incident response and notification
criteria: Incident response, agent suspension and notification paths are defined, exercised, and reachable when the owner is unavailable (succession and protected-reporting roles, ODP-04).
required_evidence: Tabletop exercise record; agent-suspension test; notification decision template

title: Customer commitments
criteria: Every commitment to the customer being activated is recorded in the obligation register and traced to a control; onboarding and termination with data return are defined.
required_evidence: Obligation register extract for the customer; contract security schedule mapped to controls

title: External assurance need
criteria: Whether any external assurance (examination, penetration test, legal advice, insurance requirement) is required before activation is assessed against actual obligations and recorded; none is assumed by default (TNT-18).
required_evidence: Recorded assessment citing the obligations considered and the outcome

title: Residual risk acceptance
criteria: Residual risks for the activated scope are listed with treatment, triggers and accepting authority; no material exception is self-approved where independence is required (ODP-02).
required_evidence: Risk register extract for the scope; recorded risk decisions with approver
